explanations.finding: FY2024 Q4/全年净利润包含 State Aid 裁决相关的一次性所得税净费用 10,246（百万美元）。Q4 GAAP 净利润14,736、调整后24,982；全年GAAP93,736、调整后103,982。gold只采用GAAP，不能将后者替换进标准答案。
explanations.table: RECONCILIATION OF NON-GAAP TO GAAP RESULTS OF OPERATIONS (Unaudited)
explanations.location: Net income row, Q4 and full-year columns; footnote (b)
explanations.original_footnote_excerpt:
(b) Non-GAAP adjustments to provision for income taxes and net income to reflect the impact of the reversal of the European General Court’s State Aid decision recognized during
the fourth quarter of 2024. On September 10, 2024, the European Court of Justice announced that it had set aside the 2020 judgment of the European General Court and
confirmed the European Commission’s 2016 State Aid decision. As a result, during the fourth quarter of 2024 the Company recorded a one-time income tax charge of $ 10.2 billion,
net, which represents $ 15.8 billion payable to Ireland via release of restricted funds held in escrow, partially offset by a U.S. foreign tax credit of $ 4.8 billion and a decrease in
unrecognized tax benefits of $ 823 million. For additional information, refer to Note 7, “Income Taxes” of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements that will be included in
Part II, Item 8 of the Company's fiscal 2024 Annual Report on Form 10-K.
(c) Represents the per-share impact of the non-GAAP adjustments to net income.
explanations.interpretation_limit: The income-tax expense is an accrual/accounting charge. Its amount must not automatically be treated as same-quarter cash taxes paid.

explanations.finding: FY2025 GAAP净利润增长19.50%，但不能全归因于经营改善。税前利润增加9,244，所得税费用减少9,030，两者合计解释净利润增加18,274；FY2024一次性税项使同比基数偏低。这里是报表算术分解，不宣称税费变化全部来自该一次性项目。

MSFT.finding_zh: 本gold的capex是现金流量表Additions to property and equipment的正数，不是管理层包含融资租赁的资本支出。FY2025 Q4现金capex为17,079百万美元（电话会四舍五入为17.1十亿美元）；管理层广义capex为24.2十亿美元，包含6.5十亿美元融资租赁，融资租赁在起租时确认全额。24.2减6.5不精确等于现金17.1，管理层仅称差异主要来自融资租赁，不应强行完全勾稽。

evidence.exact_quote: Capital expenditures were $24.2 billion, including $6.5 billion of finance leases where we recognize the full value at the time of lease commencement. Cash paid for P, P, and E, was $17.1 billion. The difference is primarily due to finance leases. More than half of our spend was on long-lived assets that will support monetization over the next 15 years and beyond. The remaining spend was primarily for servers, both CPUs and GPUs, and driven by strong demand signals.

MSFT.finding_zh: FY2024 Q4管理层称云和AI相关支出占资本支出的几乎全部，其中约一半用于数据中心等长期基础设施，其余主要是CPU/GPU服务器；FY2024全年的支出组合与Q4类似。这支持云/AI基础设施投入背景，但不能把所有现金capex或FY2025全年增长都精确归因于AI。FY2025 Q4管理层称超过一半的支出是长期资产，其余主要为CPU/GPU服务器，需求信号强劲。

evidence.exact_quote: Capital expenditures including finance leases were $19 billion, in line with expectations, and cash paid for P, P, and E was $13.9 billion. The remaining cloud and AI related spend is primarily for servers, both CPUs and GPUs, to serve customers based on demand signals. For the full fiscal year, the mix of our cloud and AI related spend was similar to Q4.

MSFT.finding_zh: FY2025全年OCF增长17,614百万美元，现金capex增长20,074百万美元，因而FCF下降2,460百万美元，即约3.32%。这是已核验数据的算术分解，不声称管理层证明了全年变动的全部因果。FY2025 Q4管理层将当季OCF增长归因于强劲云账单/收款，部分被更高供应商付款抵消；该当季说明不能外推为全年独占解释。
